python3 -c "
import json, os
logdir = 'logdir/exp_056_peginsertion_frozen_s1'
mf = os.path.join(logdir, 'metrics.jsonl')
ve = {}
ev = {}
max_step = 0
total_lines = 0
with open(mf) as f:
    for line in f:
        total_lines += 1
        m = json.loads(line)
        step = m.get('step', 0)
        max_step = max(max_step, step)
        if 'civo/ve_ratio' in m and step % 10000 <= 2500:
            ve[step] = round(m['civo/ve_ratio'], 3)
        if 'eval_return' in m:
            ev[step] = round(m['eval_return'], 2)
print(f'total_steps: {max_step}')
print(f'metrics_lines: {total_lines}')
new_ve = {s:v for s,v in ve.items() if s > 212500}
new_ev = {s:v for s,v in ev.items() if s > 212500}
if new_ve:
    print(f'NEW ve_ratio after 212.5K: {new_ve}')
if new_ev:
    print(f'NEW eval after 212.5K: {new_ev}')
if not new_ve and not new_ev:
    print('No new data after 212.5K')
ve_sorted = sorted(ve.items())
peak_s, peak_v = max(ve_sorted, key=lambda x: x[1])
final_s, final_v = ve_sorted[-1]
print(f've_ratio_peak: {peak_v} @ {peak_s}')
print(f've_ratio_final: {final_v} @ {final_s}')
ev_sorted = sorted(ev.items())
if ev_sorted:
    ep_s, ep_v = max(ev_sorted, key=lambda x: x[1])
    ef_s, ef_v = ev_sorted[-1]
    print(f'eval_peak: {ep_v} @ {ep_s}')
    print(f'eval_final: {ef_v} @ {ef_s}')
print('ve_trajectory:')
for s, v in ve_sorted:
    print(f'  {s}: {v}')
print('eval_trajectory:')
for s, v in ev_sorted:
    print(f'  {s}: {v}')
"
